usage: ratchet.py [-h] [--root ROOT]
                  {init,plan-submit,approve-plan,tests-written,red,implemented,behavior,ui-record,adv-record,complete,merged,human-approve,feedback,plan-extend,learn,pause,wait,resume,ask,accept-state,accept-finding,accept-line,raise-limit,hooks-waive,cancel,set-review,choice,ui-respec,approve-changes,providers,models,guardrail,occurrences,repeats,spec,deferred,mark-fixed,shortcuts,receipt,next,status,changes,plan-summary,brief,reviewers,check-in,triage,reviewer-status,lanes,director-key,director-enroll,lanes-start,integrate,director-policy,director-sign,fingerprint,config,view,hook,hook-stop,hook-prompt,hook-guard,install-hooks,doctor,ci-export} ...

Ratchet loop state engine

positional arguments:
  {init,plan-submit,approve-plan,tests-written,red,implemented,behavior,ui-record,adv-record,complete,merged,human-approve,feedback,plan-extend,learn,pause,wait,resume,ask,accept-state,accept-finding,accept-line,raise-limit,hooks-waive,cancel,set-review,choice,ui-respec,approve-changes,providers,models,guardrail,occurrences,repeats,spec,deferred,mark-fixed,shortcuts,receipt,next,status,changes,plan-summary,brief,reviewers,check-in,triage,reviewer-status,lanes,director-key,director-enroll,lanes-start,integrate,director-policy,director-sign,fingerprint,config,view,hook,hook-stop,hook-prompt,hook-guard,install-hooks,doctor,ci-export}
    merged              between steps, after merging main into the lane: re-
                        check earlier steps and accept the merge
    wait                end your turn while background reviewers or sub-agents
                        run, without a blocked stop
    resume              resume a paused run; --claim moves the run to this
                        chat (after `ask claim`)
    ask                 record and print the question you're about to ask the
                        user (needed before approve-plan, human-approve,
                        cancel, set-review, approve-changes, hooks-waive,
                        resume --claim, ui-respec, accept-finding, paid-
                        provider, accept-line)
    accept-state        ==SUPPRESS==
    accept-finding      record the open findings the user accepted (after `ask
                        accept-finding` and their 'accept: <reason>' reply, or
                        a director token)
    accept-line         record the unproven done-means lines the user accepted
                        (after `ask accept-line <n,..>` and their 'accept:
                        <reason>' reply, or a director token with --reason)
    raise-limit         raise one checkpoint's review-round limit by one round
                        (after `ask raise-limit` and the owning chat's own
                        'raise: <reason>' reply, or a director token with
                        --reason); offered at most once per step, ever
    hooks-waive         record the user's choice to build without hooks (after
                        `ask hooks-waive`)
    cancel              abandon the active run (needs the user's confirmation)
    set-review          change how often the user reviews (needs their
                        confirmation)
    choice              after `ask choice`: record which option the user
                        picked (or, with a director token, the letter the
                        director signed)
    ui-respec           after `ask ui-respec CPn` and the user's yes: allow
                        one change to a frozen UI check
    approve-changes     accept a user-confirmed change to the approved
                        plan/tests/rules
    providers           list, test (--check/--discover) and register (--add)
                        other agent CLIs
    models              which model each role's sub-agent uses on this host
    guardrail           after the user picks a guardrail option: add a step
                        that builds an automatic check
    occurrences         the real code where reviewers found a kind of mistake
    repeats             kinds of review finding seen twice or more, not yet
                        guarded or asked about
    spec                build from an OpenSpec change, Spec Kit feature or
                        BMAD story
    deferred            findings recorded for later instead of blocking
                        (minor, or no user_impact)
    mark-fixed          record that a deferred finding was really fixed and
                        reviewed again
    shortcuts           run the shortcut tables (tests/shortcuts/*.json) whose
                        watched files this run changed against the code the
                        run started from and the current code
    receipt             one proof receipt to paste into the pull request:
                        steps, time, reviewers, accepted/left-for-later/fixed-
                        later findings
    changes             which changes since a checkpoint's start are docs, how
                        many code lines changed, which test files name a doc,
                        and whether the docs quick path is on
    plan-summary        plain per-step summary of the plan, to show the user
                        before they approve
    brief               print a sub-agent's opening text: the plan's
                        objective, then that role's own standing rules; start
                        every spawn prompt with this instead of writing it by
                        hand
    check-in            print (or decide) the check-in opened when reviews
                        drag
    triage              record fix-or-rebut decisions for a blocked round's
                        open findings
    lanes-start         director only: start several lanes (branch, worktree,
                        enrollment, brief) from one request
    integrate           director only: merge a finished lane into main (suite
                        first), or check it with --dry-run
    director-policy     director only: show, set or clear the developer's
                        rules for routine approvals
    view                print/open the viewer link; --serve starts a live
                        server in the background
    hook                entry point for agent-CLI hooks
    install-hooks       write Ratchet's hooks into an agent CLI's config
    doctor              which hosts have Ratchet hooks, and are they firing?
    ci-export           write (or, with --stdout, print) the GitHub Actions
                        workflow that keeps running the regression command and
                        saved checks after the run ends

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           operate on the project/lane at this path (default:
                        current folder)
